# Moderation

## Moderation

**Moderation** means that the effect of one predictor depends on the value of another predictor.

::: subpoint
○ Typically equivalent to an interaction effect, like we did with ANOVAs!
:::

$$ y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i + \beta_2 z_i + \beta_3 (x_iz_i) + \epsilon $$

::: subpoint
○ $xz$: $x$ and $z$ multiplied together for each observation
:::

::: subpoint
○ $\beta_3$: the interaction effect slope
:::

We generally want to *center* the interacting variables if they are continuous



```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
```
